notes.title: About an upcoming update
notes.content:
I have been working on a 5-year anniversary update for Dr. Atominus. It's coming a bit late, but here is a sneak peak to the update and also some other important info.


A lot of polishing and quality of life updates
The update will include many small improvements to the game, like improved knockback, hard difficulty and remastered sound. There are also performance improvements and bug fixes.

Along with the update, native Linux support will be coming to Steam. It already works well with proton, but native support has some advantages, like faster startup and easier to navigate game files.


Saving system change and backwards compatibility
Recently Dr. Atominus became available for Playstation 4. A new efficient save system was added for this and it will be on the PC version too. Because of this, old save files will not be compatible with the updated game. That is why I'm telling about the update in advance, so in case you are just playing through the game, you might want to disable updates temporarily. The update will probably be coming either next week or the week after that.



I will tell more details about the update when it comes.



Edit: The update will be coming August 11.

notes.title: Dr. Atominus available now
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Dr. Atominus has been published! Get it now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294750/Dr_Atominus/

[previewyoutube=_cB6nX6ERMo;full][/previewyoutube]

Dr. Atominus is a short platformer with metroidvania elements and a cool sci-fi story.

Story
Dr. Atominus finally succeeds to magnify an atom. But the atom is alive and it escapes! Play as the atom who wants to escape from the experiments of Dr. Atominus and find out why the scientist needs you so badly.

Explore the 4th dimension, get unique abilities, and eventually, make the right choices.

Features:

     4 areas to explore
     5 bosses
     3 different endings
     Interesting sci-fi story
     Good chiptune music



Upcoming updates
I will be updating Dr. Atominus soon with these features:

  Controller support
  Main menu
  Configurable controls
  And other cool things!


Get Dr. Atominus now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294750/Dr_Atominus/

An itchio version will be available soon!

Hello everyone!

In this update I'll tell you the launch date of Dr. Atominus. Also I'll talk about some recent improvements in the game. Also there is a new trailer.

LAUNCH DATE IS SET
Dr. Atominus will launch 22.7.2020! Only three weeks from now!


NEW TRAILER
The game has changed a lot and a new trailer was needed. The existing trailer focused on the story, but this one focuses more on the gameplay. Here it is:
[previewyoutube=km-87JSpdOk;full][/previewyoutube]

RECENT IMPROVEMENTS

Map
A map was added to the game. It doesn't show your location, but it's very helpful to find new places.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37633421/f64721af2d372f6fb2ab52658e748c478a7e68ea.gif

UI
The User Interface has been improved. Blue coins were removed, because they didn't have any use. Also, now coins are health. The Atom uses energy from them to keep alive. Also, I made the pause menu a little better looking.


Bug fixes
I have also fixed dozens of bugs in the past weeks. Some of them were really weird.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37633421/8588bcd735e437678b158f06ba5f1299dfc32a9b.gif
